question: Which event is expected during direct upgrade of Cisco UCS Manager firmware?
options: The I/O Module reboots immediately after the firmware is activated.
Data traffic is disrupted for a single fabric interconnect setup.
All users logged in to the UCSM are logged out, and their sessions end.
theory: A direct firmware upgrade of Cisco UCS Manager restarts the UCS Manager management-plane process itself, and because every administrative session (GUI/CLI) is authenticated against that running process, all users currently logged in to UCS Manager are logged out and their sessions end when the upgrade activates — even though data-plane traffic through the fabric interconnects, IPMI polling, and I/O module reboot behavior are not directly triggered by this specific event. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 14 — UCS Firmware Updates, Direct Cisco UCS Manager Upgrade)
